rights_basis: Faithful bounded reading transcription of original-language liturgical text from Stowe Missal (Warner 1915 Vol. 2): complete strict Canon Missae constituent, whose United States copyright term has expired by publication date (1915 critical edition (mediating Stowe core copied ca. 792, catalogue bounds 780-820, with undated Moelcaich revisions)). Derived directly from tracked public-domain facsimile artifact.catholic-church.stowe-missal.warner-1915-vol-2.ia-scan-27c6070e without modern translation or editorial reconstruction. Third-party historical text is excluded from Triptych's CC BY 4.0 license.
text:
Hanc igitur oblationem seruitutis nostrae sed et cunctae familiae tuae quam tibi offerimus in honorem domini nostri iesu christi et in commemorationem beatorum martirum tuorum in hac aeclesiae quam famulus tuus ad honorem nominis gloriae tuae aedificauit : Quessumus domine ut placatus suscipias Eumque adque omnem populum ab idulorum cultura eripias et ad té deum uerum patrem omnipotentem conuertas :
Dies quoque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripias et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari : per dominum nostrum :
